Kings Club Casino was a casino located in Brimley, Michigan, which opened in 1984. It was the first Tribally owned casino in the United States. It was owned and operated by the Bay Mills Indian Community.
History
Kings Club Casino was opened by the Bay Mills Indian Community on July 4, 1984. It was the first gaming facility owned by a Native American tribe in the United States to include slots and blackjack games instead of just bingo. The casino closed as part of then nascent COVID-19 Pandemic on March 16, 2020. It never reopened after that and the building is slated for demolition in Spring 2025 and redeveloped as a shopping center.
Features
Kings Club Casino featured a  gaming floor with over 250 slot machines and a cafe.
